description: Deprecate the 'example-repo-local' repository by blacking it out and updating its description. Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 (admin/password). Navigate to Administration > Repositories > Repositories > Local. Select 'example-repo-local' to edit it. In the Basic settings, check the 'Blacked Out' option to disable the repository, and update the Description field to start with 'DEPRECATED: Migrated to new system'. Save the changes.
